title: PreGS: A Parameter-Transfer-Based Multi-Expert Graph Neural Network for Node Classification
abstract: arXiv:2609.26310v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph neural networks have achieved strong performance in node classification by aggregating information from graph neighborhoods. However, a single aggregation mechanism may be insufficient to capture diverse structural patterns across graph datasets. Moreover, independently training multiple structural branches can introduce substantial overhead without necessarily producing stable node representations. To address these issues, this paper proposes PreGS, a parameter-transfer-based multi-expert graph neural network framework. PreGS first pretrains a multi-head graph attention network (GAT) and transfers the linear transformation weights of its first-layer attention heads to multiple GraphSAGE experts. The transferred experts are frozen and used as complementary structural branches. translated_title: PreGS：一种基于参数迁移的多专家图神经网络用于节点分类
translated_abstract: 图神经网络通过聚合图邻域中的信息，在节点分类任务上取得了优异的性能。然而，单一的聚合机制可能不足以捕捉不同图数据集中多样的结构模式。此外，独立训练多个结构分支会带来巨大的开销，且不一定能产生稳定的节点表示。为了解决这些问题，本文提出了PreGS，一种基于参数迁移的多专家图神经网络框架。PreGS首先预训练一个多头图注意力网络（GAT），并将其第一层注意力头的线性变换权重迁移到多个GraphSAGE专家中。这些迁移后的专家被冻结，用作互补的结构分支。融合后的原始节点特征、GAT头表示和GraphSAGE专家表示被送入一个多层感知机（MLP），其输出进一步……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: PreGS通过预训练多头GAT并将其第一层注意力头权重迁移给多个冻结的GraphSAGE专家，构建了低成本的多专家图神经网络框架，从而捕捉多样的图结构模式并稳定节点表示以提升节点分类性能。
en_tdlr: PreGS is a parameter-transfer-based multi-expert graph neural network framework that pretrains a multi-head GAT and transfers its first-layer attention weights to frozen GraphSAGE experts, enabling diverse structural pattern capture with low overhead for node classification.
